domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains columns typical of retail transactional data: InvoiceNo (transaction identifier), StockCode (product identifier), Description (product description), Quantity (items per transaction), InvoiceDate (transaction timestamp), UnitPrice (product pricing), CustomerID (customer identifier), and Country (geographic market). The presence of these fields strongly suggests an e-commerce or retail sales domain.

kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of all sales revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) across all transactions, representing the business's top-line performance.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is a fundamental KPI for retail businesses, providing a single summary metric of overall sales performance. A 'card' visual is ideal for displaying this single value.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Country
kpi_specs.description: Total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) grouped by Country, identifying top revenue-generating markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Revenue by country is critical for understanding geographic performance. A bar chart effectively compares revenue across the low-cardinality 'Country' dimension.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice) aggregated by month to analyze sales trends over time.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
kpi_specs.reasoning: Tracking revenue over time is essential for identifying seasonal patterns or growth trends. A line chart is the best visual for time-series data.

kpi_specs.name: Top 10 Products by Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Top 10 products (StockCode and Description) ranked by total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice), highlighting best-selling items.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT StockCode, Description, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY StockCode, Description ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: Identifying top-performing products helps prioritize inventory and marketing efforts. A bar chart ranks products by revenue for easy comparison.

kpi_specs.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_specs.description: Average revenue per transaction (InvoiceNo), calculated as total revenue divided by the number of unique invoices.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) / COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo) AS average_order_value FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: AOV is a key retail metric for understanding customer spending behavior. A 'card' visual is appropriate for this single summary value.
